title: 83 injured as bus crashes near Barcelona

blocks.text: MADRID— A bus crash in the Barcelona area of Spain injured more than 80 people, local emergency services said Sunday. The Catalan medical emergency services said 83 people were injured, including seven people seriously, 18 less seriously and 58 with minor injuries, in the crash in Fogars de Monclús near Barcelona. Spanish news agency EFE
